notes: State expectations come from games/memory-mosaic/tests/model.py (upstream rules 3.0.0). The only emulator-derived input is origin, upstream's entropy(): each stage start samples the title-song position, logged at 0x4720 (count, values) and fed to the model in order; the shuffle and every other byte are the model's prediction. Each table is cleared by turning the pairs of the model's deal; synthetic-all-tables clears all ten. synthetic-title and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000.
